answer.text: The manual says the hazard lights keep working for 30 minutes, unless you turn them off manually.

policy.text: The hazard flasher cannot be activated when the ignition switch is OFF.

watchouts.text: Hazard flashing strains the battery, so do not use the hazard lights for longer than necessary.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not say whether turning the ignition OFF while the hazard lights are on changes the 30-minute time.
The manual's hazard lines are unclear about the ignition, so confirm with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

watchout_review.reason: Turn signal behaviour does not answer the duration question.
Lamp flashing pattern does not affect how long the hazard runs.
Battery strain from long hazard use is a warning about leaving them on.
Battery drain from the headlamp is not about the hazard lights.
Engine fault warning is unrelated to the hazard lights.
ABS warning lamp is unrelated to the hazard lights.
